source.title: Belfast Newsletter, 8 June 1964, p. 9 ("Hillsborough Rural District Council: notice of result of elections, 1964")
source.publisher: Belfast Newsletter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the returning officer’s notice of result in the Belfast News-Letter of 8 June 1964, with the counts from the report of 5 June.

note: Triennial election of Hillsborough Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Hillsborough and Anahilt were contested, Maze recorded a poll for its single candidate, and the other thirteen divisions were returned unopposed. Addresses and occupations printed with the names are not reproduced (privacy rule; gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
